scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: What is your native language?
Neha says: My native language is Hindi.
Rahul says: Wow, your English sounds really good.
Neha says: A few months ago, I couldn't speak at all and kept failing job interviews.
Rahul says: Seriously? How did you learn so fast?
Neha says: I practice speaking with Supernova AI. She understands my exact level and builds a plan just for me.
Rahul says: Wow, that's amazing. Show me.

scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: Hey Neha, how are you today?
Neha says: I was being interviewed right now.
Miss Nova says: Not 'I was', you should say 'I am being interviewed right now' because it is happening in the present.
Neha says: Oh, I am being interviewed right now.
Miss Nova says: Absolutely right. What is the interview about?
Neha says: It's about my English skills. They say me I speak with confidence.
Miss Nova says: Not 'They say me', it will be 'They say I speak with confidence'. And remember, you can make a thousand mistakes here, I will never judge you.
Neha says: You're right. They say I speak with confidence.
scenes.scene_summary:

- Payload beat (g): Explains the logic behind the grammar correction.
